description: Use correct REST verbs: GET read, POST create, PUT replace, PATCH update, DELETE remove
rationale: Consistent verb semantics make APIs predictable for clients and caches

description: Return a consistent envelope: { success, data?, error?, meta? }
rationale: Uniform shapes simplify client parsing and error handling
Wrong status codes break caches, retries, and client error handling

description: Paginate list endpoints with ?page= & ?limit= or cursor tokens
rationale: Unbounded lists exhaust memory and degrade at scale

description: Validate all user input at the boundary using Zod, Joi, or Pydantic
rationale: Boundary validation prevents injection and type confusion downstream

description: Always use parameterized queries, never string concatenation for SQL
Apply per-IP and per-user rate limits on all public endpoints
rationale: Rate limits protect against brute force and DoS

description: Load secrets from environment variables, never hardcode
rationale: Hardcoded secrets leak through VCS and CI logs

description: Configure CORS with an explicit allowlist, never * in production
rationale: Wildcard CORS exposes authenticated endpoints to CSRF

description: Catch all async errors to prevent unhandled promise rejections
rationale: Unhandled rejections crash Node processes and drop requests

description: Return structured errors with a stable error code and message
rationale: Clients need stable codes to branch on without fragile string matching

description: Never expose stack traces or internal paths to clients
rationale: Stack traces leak implementation details useful to attackers

description: Log each request with request ID, user ID, method, path, and status
rationale: Structured logs are required for debugging and SLO monitoring

description: Support Idempotency-Key header for payment and create operations
rationale: Idempotency prevents duplicate charges on client retries

description: Version APIs via URL prefix (/v1/) or Accept header
rationale: Versioning enables non-breaking evolution of contracts

description: Handle SIGTERM by draining in-flight requests before exit
rationale: Graceful shutdown prevents dropped requests during deploys
